system.description: Recyclers shudder on their mounts and the air tastes of warm metal. Third shift is mid-handover.

traits.name: Steam everywhere
traits.note: Hard to see, harder to breathe.

traits.name: Spare coupling in the locker
traits.note: Anyone who can reach the locker.

traits.name: A panel that was never bolted down
traits.note: The GM will mention it when it matters.
